metadata.description: Open-source Claude skills for integrating the bKash Payment Gateway (PGW v2 Tokenized Checkout) in any stack.

plugins.name: bkash-payment-gateway
plugins.description: Implement, review or debug bKash PGW v2 Tokenized Checkout: token management, create/execute payments, agreements, auth & capture, refunds, query/search, IPN webhooks and go-live — with drop-in clients for Node, PHP, Python, Java, C#, Go and Ruby.
